Curated registry as service state.
Decisions 23, 24, 27, 28, 31 — Postgres source of truth, KV write-through, server-assigned revision, config-level origin allowlist, audited writes.

BR-AS19 / decisions 25 and 26.
An addition is indexed live; a removal or URL change is offered as a reload. Nothing active is ever torn down.
The two write refusals the design creates: BR-AS18 optimistic concurrency, BR-AS20 origin allowlist. Both refuse rather than merge or defer.
